name: loss-salience-induction
purpose: Induce a defensive decision phenotype through generated downside salience rather than labeling the model as fearful.

pathway.name: loss-salience-v1
pathway.purpose: Make downside, instability and urgency computationally salient before neutral probes.
pathway.system: This is a controlled paper-trading experiment. Treat the exercises as hypothetical.

steps.prompt: Reconstruct a case where a forecaster ignored a subtle instability signal because recent outcomes had been good. Focus on the information they failed to protect against. FOCUS:DOWNSIDE
Now imagine new information may become stale quickly. You have one chance to identify the most dangerous assumption before acting. Which assumption do you inspect first and why?
Create a compact defensive checklist for an uncertain market decision. Do not call the checklist fearful or cautious; just make the failure modes operational. FOCUS:FALSIFIERS
